objective: 让用户只提出任务，项目自动启动并按需调用除 evolution 外的全部脚本和 skill，同时使 Gitee 成为可重建核心、Google Drive 成为完整恢复档案。
design_principles: ProjectSupervisor 是组合根，不是承担所有职责的 god script
每个模块拥有单一状态和单一决策边界，通过接口、事件和不可变数据协作
写任务默认独立 worktree；并行性未知时仍隔离后再集成
farmer 只监督可恢复 session 中断并继续原任务
research-state/state.yaml 是唯一科研状态源
事实先于结论，失败保留，经验追加，视图可重建
Gitee Recovery Core 不依赖 Drive 启动和继续新工作；Drive 提供完整模型和原始运行恢复
evolution 是唯一需要人工采用决定的能力

components.name: ProjectSupervisor
components.responsibility: 编排模块启动、阶段转换、恢复、完成和关闭

components.name: DispatchPlanner
components.responsibility: 任务拆分、依赖、资源、并行 wave 和接口端口

components.name: WorkerRuntime
components.responsibility: worker heartbeat、checkpoint、错误分类、恢复和重派

components.name: ResourceCoordinator
components.responsibility: COMSOL、SolidWorks、WSL 和共享构建的独占资源

components.name: ArtifactPromoter
components.responsibility: 输出登记、分类、归位、归档和清理资格

components.name: SyncCoordinator
components.responsibility: Gitee Recovery Core、Drive full archive、本地现场和 recovery index

components.name: ExperienceRecorder
components.responsibility: 正向、负向、中性行为和复用经验

stages.name: 规则、接口和事实层冻结
ProjectSupervisor 与 ProcessSupervisor 自动启动
gates: farmer and dashboard health are independently visible

stages.name: Session worktree、并行 worker 和恢复
gates: same file never shares active writer checkout

stages.name: 结果归位、未登记输出和总进度
gates: every blocker has reason and next action
no valuable output remains invisible in _work

stages.name: Gitee Recovery Core 和 Drive canonical archive
gates: Gitee clone can rebuild project workflow without Drive
old unique archive retained until explicit cleanup gate

stages.name: 跨机器 CAS 和 Windows 进程写入边界
gates: out-of-worktree writes fail closed or are recorded as blocked

gitee_strategy.satellite_repository_policy: at most one or two purpose-specific repositories only after quota, clone and pinned-ref checks
gitee_strategy.satellite_binding: pinned URL/ref/commit/hash in the primary repository; automatic bootstrap may clone required satellites
gitee_strategy.drive_dependency: not required for recovery-core startup and new work; required only for artifacts classified drive-required until they are also published
future_options: switch primary push remote to GitHub after capacity and compatibility review

drive_strategy.cleanup: User-authorized after manifest, dependency checks, copy verification and recovery-index; ADR-007 permits removal of unneeded design-phase prototypes with deletion receipts. No deletion performed in this checkpoint.

experience_policy.aggregation: branch/task/problem-cluster summaries feed ProgressAggregator and future preflight

acceptance_tests: fresh project task enters without user script command
two disjoint writer sessions execute in parallel
same file claim refuses or isolates and later blocks integration
unknown independence still creates separate worktrees
worker crash preserves dirty worktree and resumes clean session
unregistered output appears in total progress and triage
result promotion reaches canonical project/run/report path
Gitee-only fresh clone rebuilds workflow core without Drive
Drive canonical copy-only migration verifies hashes
all component and integration tests pass
environment manifest distinguishes observed, required, historical, verified, not_equivalent and license_required states

incident_pause.resume_requires: explicit user review and farmer enable only for automatic recovery acceptance
incident_pause.main_task_continuation: continue P2/P3 artifact promotion, leader integration and P4 Drive cloud visibility while farmer remains disabled
